main_text.l: At quæ (stupendum!) hæc ars, studiumque sit
Sic quisque manes jam patimur suos.
Qui vitam, Amico ut profit, & omnia
Sit mentis hæc una ambitio meæ;
benedicta Virgine nato, 1691. | Amor & Divina Voluntas Quo nos cunque
(a) Videfis Cogit. Ration. secundæ editionis pag.
254. & seqq. ubi de S. S. Trinitate.

page.notes: Right-hand column of the imprint block is set beside the left; order given as read across. Small stains and show-through omitted. Some letters in the scan are faint ("meditér", "Edustus") and may be misread.
